notes:
v4.6.126 — Paper and live bots run separately (no more migration)

🔀 Switching to LIVE no longer 'migrates' your bots. Paper and live each have their own bot instances on the cloud — your paper bots keep running on paper while you start separate bots on your live account, exactly like Alpaca vs IBKR already work.

• Cloud bots are now keyed by paper/live, so the same bot (e.g. LONG) can run on both at once.
• The Paper/Live switch dialog now explains this instead of warning about migration.

Live still needs your funded live account + live keys. Update via the in-app banner.
